notes: Fixed touch wake-up when the display sleeps while Settings is open.
Bundled the customized GT7 UDP parser directly with the project for reliable clean builds.
Reduced telemetry heap fragmentation by replacing per-packet dynamic buffers and removing packet dump logging.
Added the Radar dashboard theme with a circular telemetry-driven shift-light display.
Expanded Theme Selection to a four-theme 2 x 2 layout while preserving saved enum values.
Refined Radar timing, pedal, tyre-temperature, ABS/TCS, RPM, speed and gear presentation for the 320 x 240 display.
Separated high-frequency redraw regions to prevent flicker and RPM arc overlap.
Added switchable GT3, Classic, and Retro dashboard themes with persistent on-device selection; GT3 remains the default.
Added the touch Settings menu: tap an active display to open Settings, or tap a sleeping display to wake it.
Added Device Settings with persistent 20–100% brightness control and protected Wi-Fi reset access.
Refined the Classic min-alert RPM marker and increased Retro gear readability.
Added telemetry-driven RPM colours and progressive GT7 shift-warning pulse.
Introduced the refined low-RAM GT3 dashboard UI.
